chunks: The true believers will be successful,

key_terms.أَفْلَحَ: To succeed, prosper, or achieve the desired goal
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: The believers, those who have faith
key_terms.قَدْ: Indicates certainty or completion of the action

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for believers to be successful according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the criteria for true faith through the subsequent enumeration of virtues, such as humility in prayer and avoidance of idle talk. It highlights the inseparable link between inner conviction and outward ethical conduct, a theme central to the concept of 'Iman' in Al-Kulayni's *Al-Kafi*. The promise of 'falah' (success) is thus contingent upon the practical implementation of these spiritual qualities in daily life.
